title: QIDres audit on the WIN mini-index future (B3): code, specification and results
description:
Audit of the QIDres informed-trading measure (Barardehi, Dixon and Liu, Detecting Informed Trading Risk from Undercutting Activity, Journal of Finance) on market-by-order (MBO) data for the B3 mini-index future WINV25, 12 trading sessions (15–30 September 2025).

Contents: an order-book engine per matching event (validated against a reference replay), the audit specification, 20 synthetic tests, the report, a run log with approved deviations and a pre-registration, and small derived results. Raw exchange data is not included; the README explains how to regenerate the large intermediate files from B3 UMDF MBO data.

Documentation is in Portuguese.
